title: Software Developer Career Roadmap
description: Progressive roadmap covering computational logic, data structures, backend persistence, clean code, and engineering interview readiness.
totalEstimatedDuration: 8 - 14 Months self-paced study or concurrent academic preparation
durationBreakdown: Programming & Logic: 2-3 mos | DSA Mastery: 3-5 mos | Projects & Version Control: 2-3 mos | System Design & Interviews: 2-3 mos
overlapNotes: Stage 2 (DSA) and Stage 3 (Projects) can proceed in parallel to solidify theoretical concepts with practical software development.

steps.title: Programming Foundations & Computer Science Logic
steps.description: Master variables, memory allocation, control flow, functions, modular architecture, and object-oriented paradigms in Java, C++, or Python.
activities: Solve 60+ algorithmic challenges on HackerRank/Codewars
Build console-based utilities (e.g. Bank Account Management, Library System)
steps.completionCriteria: Able to write clean, modular, syntax-error-free code adhering to standard indentation and naming conventions.
steps.dependencies: Basic high school mathematics and algorithmic logic.

steps.title: Data Structures & Algorithmic Problem Solving
steps.description: Implement core data structures from scratch and analyze asymptotic time and space complexities (Big-O notation).
activities: Solve 150+ LeetCode problems (Easy to Medium)
Implement standard sorting and searching algorithms
steps.completionCriteria: Consistently solve LeetCode Medium problems within 30 minutes with optimal time complexity.

steps.title: Databases, API Engineering & Version Control
steps.description: Design normalized relational databases, build RESTful endpoints, and manage collaborative codebases with Git branching models.
activities: Build and deploy 2 production-ready micro-projects on GitHub
Write database migrations and normalized SQL queries
steps.completionCriteria: Live deployed application repository with README, unit test coverage, and documentation.
steps.dependencies: Data structures and basic programming competency.

steps.title: Practical Internship, Interview Prep & System Design
steps.description: Prepare behavioral and technical interview questions, understand basic low-level system design, and apply for developer openings.
activities: Conduct 5+ peer mock interviews on Pramp/Interviewing.io
Apply to campus placement drives and AngelList/LinkedIn openings
steps.completionCriteria: Secure an internship or entry-level software development offer.
steps.dependencies: Completed portfolio projects and strong DSA problem-solving.

title: Frontend Developer Learning Roadmap
description: Step-by-step progression from semantic HTML and CSS to modern TypeScript, component state architecture, and web performance.
durationBreakdown: HTML, CSS & Responsive Design: 6-8 weeks | JavaScript ES6+ & Async: 8-10 weeks | React & State Management: 8-10 weeks | Performance & CI/CD: 4 weeks
overlapNotes: Styling frameworks like Tailwind CSS are practiced while writing JavaScript and React component code.

steps.title: Semantic HTML5, Modern CSS3 & Responsive Architecture
steps.description: Master document semantics, accessibility (WCAG), CSS Flexbox, Grid, mobile-first media queries, and utility CSS (Tailwind).
activities: Recreate 3 pixel-perfect responsive landing pages
Test accessibility using Lighthouse and screen readers
steps.completionCriteria: Build a mobile-first responsive web page achieving 95+ score on Google Lighthouse.

steps.title: Core JavaScript (ES6+), DOM & Asynchronous Programming
steps.description: Understand execution context, closures, event loop, Promises, Async/Await, and REST API consumption using Fetch.
activities: Build an interactive single-page vanilla JS app (e.g. Weather dashboard, E-commerce cart)
Debug asynchronous network errors in Chrome DevTools
steps.completionCriteria: Able to manipulate DOM, consume third-party JSON APIs, and handle loading/error states cleanly in vanilla JavaScript.

steps.title: React.js, Component State & Client-Side Routing
steps.description: Master component hierarchy, React Hooks (useState, useEffect, useMemo, useCallback), routing with React Router, and state management.
activities: Build a full-featured CRUD web application (e.g. Kanban task management or Job Board)
Integrate responsive UI components with clean state
steps.completionCriteria: Deployed React application with multi-route navigation, complex state persistence, and responsive UI.

steps.title: TypeScript, Next.js & Production Web Performance
steps.description: Adopt static typing with TypeScript, implement SSR/SSG with Next.js, and optimize Core Web Vitals.
activities: Migrate a React application to TypeScript and Next.js
Deploy on Vercel with automated GitHub CI/CD workflow
steps.completionCriteria: Production-ready Next.js web application deployed with TypeScript and automated CI/CD checks.

title: Backend Developer Learning Roadmap
description: Comprehensive curriculum from server runtime and database normalization to REST/gRPC API architecture, security, and message brokers.
durationBreakdown: Server Language & Runtimes: 6-8 weeks | Database Modeling & SQL: 6-8 weeks | REST APIs, Auth & Security: 6 weeks | Caching, Queues & Microservices: 6-8 weeks
overlapNotes: API security and testing should be implemented directly within your project development stages.

steps.title: Server Runtime & Asynchronous I/O Fundamentals
steps.description: Master server-side programming in Node.js (Express/Fastify), Java (Spring Boot), Go, or Python (FastAPI). Understand non-blocking I/O and process models.
activities: Write command-line servers handling concurrent HTTP requests
Implement structured logging using Winston/Pino
steps.completionCriteria: Build a modular HTTP server capable of serving dynamic routes with input validation.

steps.title: Database Architecture, SQL Normalization & NoSQL
steps.description: Design normalized relational schemas in PostgreSQL/MySQL, understand indexing (B-Tree), transactions (ACID), and document databases like MongoDB.
activities: Design an e-commerce relational schema with foreign key constraints
Analyze slow queries using EXPLAIN ANALYZE in PostgreSQL
steps.completionCriteria: Normalized 3NF relational database schema with indexed queries and transaction rollbacks.

steps.title: API Architecture, Authentication & Security
steps.description: Build secure RESTful endpoints, implement JWT/OAuth2 authentication, password hashing (bcrypt), CORS, rate limiting, and input sanitization.
activities: Build an end-to-end user authentication and role-based access control (RBAC) microservice
Write integration tests using Supertest/Postman
steps.completionCriteria: Secure REST API with role-based authentication, Swagger documentation, and automated tests.

steps.title: Caching, Message Queues & Distributed Scale
steps.description: Integrate Redis for in-memory caching and session stores, implement asynchronous task processing using RabbitMQ or Kafka, and containerize with Docker.
activities: Implement Redis caching layer reducing database query response times by 80%
Containerize the backend with multi-stage Dockerfile and docker-compose
steps.completionCriteria: Containerized microservice stack utilizing Redis caching and background worker queue.
steps.dependencies: Secure REST API and database proficiency.

title: Full-Stack Developer Learning Roadmap
description: Structured journey spanning client UI engineering, server REST architecture, database modeling, and end-to-end cloud deployment.
durationBreakdown: Frontend Foundations & React: 3-4 mos | Backend API & SQL/NoSQL: 3-4 mos | Full-Stack Integration & Auth: 2 mos | DevOps, CI/CD & Cloud Deployment: 2 mos
overlapNotes: Backend endpoints and frontend state management are wired up continuously during project stages.

steps.title: Client-Side Engineering with React & Tailwind
steps.description: Master HTML5, CSS3, modern JavaScript ES6+, React component architecture, hooks, and responsive design systems.
activities: Build 3 interactive UI applications with mock API data
Ensure accessibility and mobile responsiveness
steps.completionCriteria: Deployed React front-end application with dynamic state and routing.

steps.title: Server Engineering & Database Design
steps.description: Build backend services using Node.js/Express, Python/FastAPI, or Java Spring; design relational schemas (PostgreSQL) and NoSQL (MongoDB).
activities: Build a standalone REST API with multi-table database relationships
Implement secure registration and login with bcrypt and JWT
steps.completionCriteria: Fully functional REST API with complete CRUD operations, database migrations, and unit tests.

steps.title: Full-Stack Integration, WebSockets & Security
steps.description: Connect client applications to custom backend services, implement real-time communication with WebSockets (Socket.io), and handle payments.
activities: Build an end-to-end SaaS project (e.g. Collaborative Whiteboard, Multi-vendor Marketplace)
Integrate Razorpay test mode payments and webhooks
steps.completionCriteria: Live production SaaS application handling real-time events, authentication, and payments.

steps.title: DevOps, Containerization & Production Cloud Hosting
steps.description: Package full-stack applications with Docker, configure automated GitHub Actions CI/CD pipelines, and deploy on AWS, Render, or Vercel.
activities: Write multi-stage Dockerfiles for client and server
Setup automated testing and auto-deployment on Git push
steps.completionCriteria: Custom domain website running via Docker containers with automated CI/CD and monitoring.

title: Native Android Developer Learning Roadmap
description: Modern Android curriculum aligned with Google official architecture: Kotlin, Jetpack Compose, Coroutines, Flow, Room, and Hilt.
durationBreakdown: Kotlin Language Mastery: 4-6 weeks | Jetpack Compose UI: 6-8 weeks | Coroutines, Flow & Retrofit: 6 weeks | Room, Hilt & Store Launch: 6 weeks
overlapNotes: Kotlin language syntax is mastered in the context of Android UI programming.

steps.title: Kotlin Programming & Android Studio Foundations
steps.description: Master modern Kotlin syntax: null safety, data classes, extension functions, lambdas, and Android Studio IDE tooling.
activities: Solve 40+ Kotlin coding challenges on JetBrains Academy
Configure multi-module Gradle project structure
steps.completionCriteria: Write idiomatic Kotlin code utilizing collections, higher-order functions, and extension methods without warnings.

steps.title: Declarative UI with Jetpack Compose & Navigation
steps.description: Build modern declarative Android UIs using Jetpack Compose, State Hoisting, Modifiers, Theming, and Compose Navigation.
activities: Build a multi-screen media streaming UI in Jetpack Compose
Implement custom micro-animations and swipe-to-dismiss
steps.completionCriteria: Fluid 60fps declarative UI with multi-screen navigation and Material Design 3 theming.

steps.title: Asynchronous Coroutines, StateFlow & Retrofit Networking
steps.description: Handle background threads with Kotlin Coroutines, manage reactive streams with StateFlow/SharedFlow, and parse JSON APIs using Retrofit and Moshi.
activities: Connect Compose UI to a public REST API (e.g. GitHub API or TMDB Movies)
Handle network pagination, error states, and image caching with Coil
steps.completionCriteria: Real-time REST API app consuming paginated network data seamlessly with Coroutines.

steps.title: Local Persistence (Room), Hilt DI & App Publication
steps.description: Implement Room SQLite database for offline caching, inject dependencies with Dagger-Hilt, write unit tests with JUnit/Mockk, and publish on Google Play.
activities: Architect a production-grade offline-first app following Google Now in Android architecture
Publish signed bundle to Google Play internal/open testing track
steps.completionCriteria: Published native Android app with MVVM architecture, Room offline persistence, and Hilt injection.

title: Native iOS Developer Learning Roadmap
description: Step-by-step native engineering curriculum: Swift language mastery, SwiftUI declarative views, Async/Await concurrency, SwiftData, and App Store submission.
durationBreakdown: Swift Language & OOP: 6 weeks | SwiftUI & HIG Layouts: 6-8 weeks | Networking, Async/Await & Architecture: 6 weeks | SwiftData & App Store Launch: 4-6 weeks
overlapNotes: Design aesthetics according to Apple Human Interface Guidelines are learned while coding SwiftUI views.

steps.title: Swift Language Foundations & Xcode Environment
steps.description: Master Swift syntax, optionals, structs vs classes, protocols, generics, closures, and Xcode debugging instruments.
activities: Complete 50+ Swift Playground exercises on 100 Days of SwiftUI
Build modular command line tools using Swift Package Manager (SPM)
steps.completionCriteria: Write idiomatic Swift code without force-unwrapping optionals and with zero ARC memory leaks.
steps.dependencies: Basic programming concept knowledge and access to macOS.

steps.title: Declarative UI with SwiftUI & Apple HIG
steps.description: Build native iOS interfaces adhering to Apple Human Interface Guidelines using SwiftUI Views, Modifiers, State, Binding, and NavigationStack.
activities: Recreate 3 pixel-perfect Apple native apps (e.g. Weather, Reminders, Apple Music clone)
Implement fluid spring animations and haptic feedback
steps.completionCriteria: Fluid, accessible SwiftUI application supporting Dark Mode and dynamic text sizing.

steps.title: Modern Concurrency (Async/Await), URLSession & Architecture
steps.description: Fetch network JSON data asynchronously with Swift Modern Concurrency (async/await, Tasks, Actors) and structure code with MVVM.
activities: Build a crypto price tracking or movie discovery app consuming public REST APIs
Write unit tests for ViewModels mocking URLProtocol network responses
steps.completionCriteria: Decoupled MVVM iOS app with async networking, unit tests, and robust error handling.

steps.title: Local Persistence (SwiftData/CoreData) & App Store Release
steps.description: Persist data locally using SwiftData, manage App Store Connect metadata, configure TestFlight builds, and submit for Apple Review.
activities: Build a complete personal finance or fitness tracking app with SwiftData persistence
Publish application to TestFlight and successfully clear App Store Review
steps.completionCriteria: Live published application on Apple App Store or active TestFlight public link.

title: Game Developer Learning Roadmap
description: Progressive game development journey from 2D mechanics and linear algebra to 3D engine physics, AI state machines, and multiplatform publishing.
durationBreakdown: Mathematics for Games & C#/C++: 6-8 weeks | 2D Game Mechanics & Architecture: 8 weeks | 3D Graphics, Lighting & Physics: 8-10 weeks | Audio, AI & Polishing: 6 weeks
overlapNotes: Math concepts are practiced by writing shaders and physics movement algorithms directly inside the game engine.

steps.title: Mathematics for Games & Core Engine Scripting
steps.description: Master vectors (dot product, cross product), quaternions, trigonometry, and C# scripting inside Unity or C++ inside Unreal Engine.
activities: Build a 2D arcade game (e.g. Pong, Asteroids clone) from scratch
Implement custom kinematic character movement without built-in physics
steps.completionCriteria: Smooth playable 2D arcade game with responsive controls and collision detection.
steps.dependencies: Basic programming literacy and high school mathematics.

steps.title: 2D Platformer Mechanics, Tilemaps & Animation Controllers
steps.description: Implement raycast collisions, state machine driven character animations, tilemaps, collectible items, and sound effect managers.
activities: Build a complete 3-level 2D platformer with enemy patrol logic, health system, and checkpoint saves
Publish the playable WebGL build on itch.io
steps.completionCriteria: Playable 2D platformer hosted online on itch.io with zero game-breaking bugs.

steps.title: 3D Gameplay Programming, Physics & Lighting
steps.description: Transition to 3D space: first-person/third-person cameras, Rigidbody physics, raycasting, baking lighting, particle effects, and navmesh pathfinding.
activities: Build a 3D third-person action game prototype featuring enemy melee AI and ragdoll physics
Profile draw calls and frame rate optimization on target device
steps.completionCriteria: Playable 3D combat prototype with smart AI navigation and stable 60fps performance.

steps.title: Game Polish, Mobile Optimization & Portfolio Showcase
steps.description: Polish game feel (camera shake, sound design, UI juice), optimize draw calls and textures for mobile/PC, and prepare video showcases.
activities: Participate in a 48-hour Game Jam (e.g. Ludum Dare or Global Game Jam)
Package an APK for Android or executable for Steam/itch.io
steps.completionCriteria: Portfolio featuring 2+ polished playable games with gameplay video reels ready for studio evaluation.

title: Data Analyst Career Roadmap
description: Comprehensive pathway covering advanced Excel, SQL query optimization, Python data wrangling (Pandas), and interactive BI dashboard design.
durationBreakdown: Advanced Excel & Business Math: 3-4 weeks | SQL Querying & Joins: 4-6 weeks | BI Dashboarding (Power BI/Tableau): 4-6 weeks | Python Data Wrangling: 4 weeks
overlapNotes: Real-world business case studies are applied across all stages.

steps.title: Advanced Microsoft Excel & Business Statistics
steps.description: Master lookup formulas (XLOOKUP, INDEX/MATCH), pivot tables, data cleaning, descriptive statistics (mean, median, standard deviation), and business KPI tracking.
activities: Analyze an e-commerce sales spreadsheet with 50,000+ rows using pivot tables and slicers
Create an automated executive summary dashboard in Excel
steps.completionCriteria: Build an automated Excel workbook that cleans raw data, computes key ratios, and visualizes summary charts.

steps.title: Advanced SQL Querying & Database Analytics
steps.description: Write complex SQL queries utilizing multi-table joins, subqueries, Common Table Expressions (CTEs), and window functions (ROW_NUMBER, DENSE_RANK, LAG, LEAD).
activities: Solve 50+ business SQL challenges on StrataScratch / LeetCode Database
Calculate Monthly Active Users (MAU) and Customer Retention cohorts using window functions
steps.completionCriteria: Pass medium-to-hard SQL interview assessments within 25 minutes with optimal query syntax.

steps.title: Business Intelligence Dashboards (Power BI / Tableau)
steps.description: Connect to databases, build star-schema data models, write DAX calculations (CALCULATE, RELATED, Time Intelligence), and design executive dashboards.
activities: Build an interactive Sales & Inventory Performance Dashboard in Power BI
Publish to NovyPro / Tableau Public with documentation of business insights
steps.completionCriteria: Published interactive Power BI/Tableau dashboard demonstrating business insights and clear action items.

steps.title: Python for Data Analysis (Pandas, NumPy, Seaborn)
steps.description: Use Python in Jupyter Notebooks to clean messy CSV/JSON datasets, handle missing values, perform exploratory data analysis (EDA), and create statistical charts.
activities: Perform end-to-end EDA on a Kaggle dataset (e.g. Telecom Customer Churn or Swiggy Restaurant Analysis)
Write clean, commented Jupyter Notebook summary reports
steps.completionCriteria: Completed EDA notebook published on GitHub with visual correlation heatmaps and actionable conclusions.

title: Data Scientist Learning Roadmap
description: Comprehensive curriculum from mathematical foundations (calculus, probability) to supervised/unsupervised machine learning, deep learning, and production deployment.
durationBreakdown: Mathematics & Statistics: 8 weeks | Classical Machine Learning: 10 weeks | Deep Learning Foundations: 8 weeks | Production ML & Deployment: 6 weeks
overlapNotes: Statistical theory is validated by coding algorithms from scratch in Python.

steps.title: Mathematical Foundations for Machine Learning
steps.description: Master linear algebra (eigenvectors, SVD), multivariable calculus (gradient descent), and probability distributions (Bayes theorem, hypothesis testing).
activities: Implement linear regression and gradient descent from scratch in Python without Scikit-Learn
Conduct a statistical A/B test simulation with p-value calculations
steps.completionCriteria: Able to mathematically derive gradient descent and explain mathematical assumptions behind linear and logistic regression.
steps.dependencies: Undergraduate engineering mathematics or calculus basics.

steps.title: Supervised & Unsupervised Machine Learning Algorithms
steps.description: Master algorithms using Scikit-Learn: Decision Trees, Random Forests, Gradient Boosting (XGBoost, LightGBM), K-Means, and PCA dimensionality reduction.
activities: Compete in 2 Kaggle tabular competitions achieving top 25% rank
Analyze feature importances using SHAP (SHapley Additive exPlanations) values
steps.completionCriteria: Build an end-to-end predictive pipeline with cross-validation, hyperparameter tuning, and SHAP explainability.

steps.title: Deep Learning & Neural Network Foundations
steps.description: Understand backpropagation, activation functions, regularizations (Dropout, BatchNorm), and construct multi-layer perceptrons in PyTorch.
activities: Build a neural network classifier in PyTorch from scratch
Train and fine-tune a Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) on image data
steps.completionCriteria: PyTorch model trained with custom datasets achieving verified convergence without vanishing gradients.

steps.title: Model Serving, API Deployment & MLOps Basics
steps.description: Package machine learning models into microservices using FastAPI, containerize with Docker, and deploy to cloud platforms with monitoring.
activities: Build an interactive Streamlit or web demo showcasing the live ML model
Deploy the prediction API inside a Docker container on AWS EC2
steps.completionCriteria: Live accessible web application executing real-time ML inferences via a documented REST API.

title: Data Engineer Learning Roadmap
description: Comprehensive curriculum spanning advanced data modeling, distributed computing with Apache Spark, real-time streaming with Kafka, and modern cloud data warehouses.
durationBreakdown: Advanced SQL & Data Modeling: 6 weeks | Python, PySpark & Distributed Computing: 8-10 weeks | Data Orchestration (Airflow) & Warehouses: 6-8 weeks | Streaming Data with Kafka: 6 weeks
overlapNotes: Airflow orchestration and Docker deployment are practiced during pipeline development.

steps.title: Advanced SQL, Relational Architecture & Dimensional Modeling
steps.description: Master data warehousing concepts: Kimball dimensional modeling (fact vs dimension tables, star vs snowflake schemas), and complex analytical SQL.
activities: Design a data warehouse schema for a multi-channel retail business
Write SQL queries computing rolling 30-day customer lifetime values
steps.completionCriteria: Normalized and star-schema warehouse designs with documented SCD Type 2 handling.

steps.title: Distributed Big Data Processing with Apache Spark & PySpark
steps.description: Understand cluster computing, RDDs, DataFrames, Spark SQL, partitioning, shuffle operations, and the Parquet/Delta Lake columnar file format.
activities: Process a 10GB+ public dataset (e.g. NYC Taxi or GitHub Archive) using PySpark
Benchmark query performance between CSV, JSON, and partitioned Parquet files
steps.completionCriteria: PySpark job executing data aggregations on millions of rows with minimal shuffle overhead.

steps.title: Data Pipeline Orchestration (Apache Airflow) & Cloud Warehouses
steps.description: Schedule, monitor, and backfill production data workflows using Apache Airflow DAGs, and load transformed data into Snowflake or BigQuery.
activities: Build an automated daily ELT pipeline in Airflow extracting API data, transforming with dbt, and loading into Snowflake
Configure Slack alert notifications for pipeline failures
steps.completionCriteria: Production-ready automated Airflow DAG executing reliable data transformation runs with alerting.

steps.title: Real-Time Streaming with Apache Kafka & CI/CD
steps.description: Implement real-time pub/sub event streaming with Apache Kafka, stream processing with Spark Streaming or Flink, and automate deployment.
activities: Build a real-time event streaming pipeline processing sensor/clickstream telemetry with Kafka and Spark
Deploy the complete data stack via docker-compose on AWS
steps.completionCriteria: Working real-time streaming pipeline processing events with sub-second latency into a data lake.

title: Machine Learning Engineer Career Roadmap
description: Progression from applied ML modeling and PyTorch deep learning to model serving (FastAPI/Triton), containerization, and automated MLOps pipelines.
durationBreakdown: Applied ML & Math: 8 weeks | Deep Learning with PyTorch: 10 weeks | Model Serving & Optimization (ONNX/TensorRT): 6-8 weeks | MLOps, CI/CD & Monitoring: 6-8 weeks
overlapNotes: Model quantization and deployment are built on top of the deep learning projects.

steps.title: Applied Machine Learning & Feature Engineering Pipelines
steps.description: Master data preprocessing, feature engineering pipelines (Scikit-Learn ColumnTransformer), gradient boosting (XGBoost/LightGBM), and evaluation metrics (ROC-AUC, F1).
activities: Build an end-to-end reproducible tabular classification pipeline on a real-world dataset
Serialize pipelines using Joblib/ONNX
steps.completionCriteria: Reproducible feature engineering and ML training script with unit tests and baseline metrics.
steps.dependencies: Python programming and linear algebra/statistics basics.

steps.title: Deep Learning with PyTorch & Model Architectures
steps.description: Build neural network architectures in PyTorch, implement custom loss functions, training loops with mixed-precision (AMP), and fine-tune pre-trained models.
activities: Train a computer vision or text classifier in PyTorch using transfer learning
Track experiment loss curves and metrics using Weights & Biases
steps.completionCriteria: Trained deep learning model converging with documented validation metrics and experiment tracking.

steps.title: Model Serving, Quantization & Low-Latency Inference
steps.description: Package models for inference using FastAPI, optimize models with ONNX Runtime and TensorRT, reduce latency via quantization (FP16/INT8), and batch requests.
activities: Convert a PyTorch model to ONNX format and benchmark 3x throughput improvement
Deploy an asynchronous FastAPI inference service handling 50 concurrent requests
steps.completionCriteria: Benchmarked low-latency inference microservice serving predictions with sub-50ms latency.

steps.title: MLOps, Continuous Integration & Drift Monitoring
steps.description: Implement ML model registry (MLflow), data versioning (DVC), automated retraining pipelines with GitHub Actions, and data/concept drift monitoring (Evidently AI).
activities: Build an automated MLOps pipeline on GitHub that triggers retraining when data drifts
Deploy the complete containerized solution on AWS ECS with CloudWatch monitoring
steps.completionCriteria: Production-ready MLOps pipeline featuring model registry, automated testing, and live drift alerts.

title: AI Engineer (Generative AI & LLMs) Roadmap
description: Modern engineering roadmap from prompt engineering and vector embeddings to advanced Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) and autonomous multi-agent systems.
durationBreakdown: LLM Fundamentals & Prompt Engineering: 4 weeks | Vector Databases & Embeddings: 4-6 weeks | Production RAG Architecture: 6-8 weeks | Fine-Tuning & Multi-Agent Workflows: 6-8 weeks
overlapNotes: Evaluation frameworks (Ragas/TruLens) are introduced during RAG implementation.

steps.title: LLM Foundations, API Integration & Prompt Engineering
steps.description: Master foundation models (GPT-4, Claude, Gemini, Llama 3), API integrations, structured outputs (JSON mode), and advanced prompt techniques (Few-Shot, Chain-of-Thought).
activities: Build an automated data extraction and summarization CLI using Python and OpenAI/Gemini APIs
Implement robust error retry logic and fallback models
steps.completionCriteria: Production-ready Python utility parsing unstructured documents into validated Pydantic models.
steps.dependencies: Proficiency in Python programming and REST APIs.

steps.title: Embeddings, Vector Databases & Semantic Search
steps.description: Understand high-dimensional vector embeddings, cosine similarity, indexing algorithms (HNSW), and setup vector databases (Pinecone, Qdrant, ChromaDB, PGVector).
activities: Index 1,000+ technical PDF documents into a vector database with metadata filtering
Benchmark search accuracy between pure semantic and hybrid keyword search
steps.completionCriteria: Fast semantic search engine returning top-k relevant document chunks within 100ms.

steps.title: Production RAG Architecture & Hallucination Guardrails
steps.description: Build enterprise Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines: document chunking strategies, re-ranking (Cohere Rerank), query transformation, and evaluation with Ragas.
activities: Build an interactive enterprise knowledge base assistant for internal documentation
Evaluate and benchmark RAG accuracy using Ragas or TruLens frameworks
steps.completionCriteria: Production-ready RAG application with 90%+ measured faithfulness and verifiable citation links.

steps.title: Autonomous Multi-Agent Workflows & Local Model Fine-Tuning
steps.description: Orchestrate multi-agent systems using LangGraph or CrewAI, integrate external tools via function calling, and fine-tune open models (Llama 3, Mistral) with LoRA/QLoRA.
activities: Build an autonomous financial research agent team that searches the web, analyzes reports, and writes a synthesis document
Fine-tune an open-source 8B model using HuggingFace and Unsloth on Google Colab
steps.completionCriteria: Working multi-agent system executing multi-step autonomous tool calls and a fine-tuned specialized model.

title: AI Research Scientist Career Roadmap
description: Rigorous academic and research roadmap from mathematical theory and foundational literature review to novel architectural design and international conference publications.
durationBreakdown: Advanced Mathematical Rigor & Coursework: 1-2 years | Research Literature & Hypothesis Formulation: 1 year | Laboratory Experimentation & Novel Architectures: 2 years | Dissertation Defense & Conference Publishing: 1-2 years
overlapNotes: Coursework and conference submissions proceed concurrently during doctoral studies.

steps.title: Advanced Mathematics, Optimization & Statistical Theory
steps.description: Master convex and non-convex optimization, stochastic gradient methods, measure-theoretic probability, information theory, and matrix analysis.
activities: Clear GATE with top percentile and secure Ph.D. research fellowship at IISc/IIT
Complete advanced graduate coursework in Machine Learning Theory with A+ grades
steps.completionCriteria: Clear comprehensive Ph.D. qualifying examination (CQE) and obtain doctoral candidacy.
steps.dependencies: Undergraduate engineering mathematics or Master's degree.

steps.title: Literature Review, Novel Hypothesis & Baseline Replication
steps.description: Perform deep critical surveys of state-of-the-art literature across NeurIPS/ICML/CVPR, replicate landmark research papers, and identify open theoretical bottlenecks.
activities: Replicate the mathematical claims and experimental results of 3 recent NeurIPS papers from scratch
Present research proposal to doctoral advisory committee
steps.completionCriteria: Approved doctoral research proposal with verified experimental baselines.

steps.title: Novel Algorithmic Experimentation & Conference Publication
steps.description: Design novel deep learning architectures, formulate mathematical proofs of convergence, conduct extensive ablation experiments on GPU clusters, and draft papers.
activities: Submit primary author research paper to NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, or CVPR
Incorporate peer reviewer feedback during the conference rebuttal phase
steps.completionCriteria: At least 2 primary author publications accepted in CORE A* or Scopus-indexed top-tier conferences.

steps.title: Dissertation Defense & Corporate Lab Colloquium
steps.description: Author and defend doctoral thesis, present research colloquiums at corporate research labs (MSR, Google, IBM), and secure research scientist appointments.
activities: Successfully defend Ph.D. dissertation before an international evaluation committee
Complete research internship at an industrial AI research laboratory
steps.completionCriteria: Ph.D. degree conferral and appointment as Research Scientist at a premier laboratory.

title: Cybersecurity Analyst (SOC) Learning Roadmap
description: Defensive security pathway: computer networking, Linux/Windows system internals, SIEM alert triage, incident response, and MITRE ATT&CK framework mapping.
durationBreakdown: Networking (TCP/IP) & Operating Systems: 6-8 weeks | Security Fundamentals & Threat Landscape: 6 weeks | SIEM Tooling & Log Analysis: 6-8 weeks | Incident Response & Digital Forensics: 6 weeks
overlapNotes: Packet analysis in Wireshark is practiced while learning networking protocols.

steps.title: Computer Networking, Protocol Analysis & OS Internals
steps.description: Master OSI model, TCP/IP handshake, DNS, DHCP, HTTP/HTTPS, packet analysis using Wireshark, and Linux/Windows administration commands.
activities: Capture and inspect unencrypted HTTP traffic and DNS queries using Wireshark
Analyze Windows event logs (Event ID 4624/4625 login events)
steps.completionCriteria: Identify network anomalies, malicious domain lookups, and port scans in Wireshark packet captures.

steps.title: Threat Landscape, MITRE ATT&CK & Defense Concepts
steps.description: Understand common cyber attacks (phishing, malware, brute force, SQL injection), defense-in-depth, firewalls, and map tactics to the MITRE ATT&CK framework.
activities: Map a real-world ransomware case study to MITRE ATT&CK techniques
Run an authorized vulnerability scan using OpenVAS in a virtual lab
steps.completionCriteria: Comprehensive vulnerability report detailing risk severity scores (CVSS) and remediation steps.

steps.title: SIEM Operations, Splunk / ELK & Log Analysis
steps.description: Collect, parse, and analyze security logs using Security Information and Event Management (SIEM) tools like Splunk or ELK Stack; author detection alerts.
skillsToAcquire: SIEM Alert Triage & False Positive Reduction
activities: Setup a home lab ingesting Windows Sysmon logs into Splunk
Write SPL queries to detect password spraying and privilege escalation attempts
steps.completionCriteria: Functional SIEM dashboard monitoring simulated enterprise network events with automated alert rules.

steps.title: Incident Response, Memory Forensics & Blue Team Labs
steps.description: Execute structured Incident Response (NIST/SANS 6-step framework), capture volatile RAM memory (Volatility), investigate phishing emails, and earn certifications.
activities: Investigate 20+ realistic incident response scenarios on LetsDefend or TryHackMe Blue Team tracks
Write a formal security incident report documenting containment, eradication, and lessons learned
steps.completionCriteria: Earn a blue team certification (CompTIA Security+ or BTL1) and complete 10+ documented SOC lab writeups.

title: Security Engineer (AppSec & Pentesting) Roadmap
description: Comprehensive curriculum from web application vulnerability identification (OWASP Top 10) and Burp Suite mastery to network penetration testing and DevSecOps pipelines.
durationBreakdown: Web Application Vulnerabilities (OWASP): 8 weeks | Penetration Testing Tools (Burp Suite, Metasploit): 8 weeks | Network Exploitation & Privilege Escalation: 8-10 weeks | DevSecOps & Cloud Security: 6 weeks
overlapNotes: Hands-on Hack The Box and PortSwigger labs are completed alongside study topics.

steps.title: Web Application Vulnerabilities (OWASP Top 10)
steps.description: Master core web vulnerabilities: SQL Injection, Cross-Site Scripting (XSS), Cross-Site Request Forgery (CSRF), Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF), and Broken Authentication.
activities: Complete 50+ apprentice and practitioner labs on PortSwigger Web Security Academy
Manually exploit SQL injection vulnerabilities in a sandbox environment
steps.completionCriteria: Clear all core PortSwigger vulnerability assessment labs without using automated tools.
steps.dependencies: Understanding of HTTP protocol, JavaScript, and SQL databases.

steps.title: Interception Proxies, Burp Suite & API Penetration Testing
steps.description: Master Burp Suite Professional features: Repeater, Intruder, Collaborator, Extender, and test RESTful/GraphQL endpoints for unauthorized data leakage.
activities: Perform an authorized penetration test on an open-source vulnerable web app (e.g. OWASP Juice Shop)
Document identified vulnerabilities following standard CVSS scoring
steps.completionCriteria: Professional penetration testing report documenting proof-of-concept exploits and remediation recommendations.

steps.title: Network Penetration Testing & Privilege Escalation
steps.description: Scan targets with Nmap, exploit vulnerable network services using Metasploit, and escalate privileges on Linux (sudo, SUID binaries) and Windows (Token impersonation).
activities: Root 15+ target machines on Hack The Box or TryHackMe
Write custom Python automation scripts to automate repetitive exploit payloads
steps.completionCriteria: Successfully compromise and obtain root/system flags on 15 intermediate Hack The Box machines.

steps.title: DevSecOps Automation & Cloud Infrastructure Security
steps.description: Embed Static Application Security Testing (SAST) and Dependency Checking (Trivy, Snyk) into GitHub Actions pipelines, and audit cloud security with ScoutSuite.
activities: Integrate automated Snyk vulnerability scanning into a GitHub Actions pipeline that fails builds on high-severity vulnerabilities
Perform a cloud security audit on AWS using ScoutSuite and remediate misconfigured S3 buckets
steps.completionCriteria: Fully automated DevSecOps CI/CD pipeline preventing vulnerable code and leaked API secrets from reaching production.

title: Cloud Engineer Career Roadmap
description: Progression from Linux system administration and cloud networking to core cloud services (AWS/Azure), Infrastructure as Code (Terraform), and security.
durationBreakdown: Linux & Cloud Networking (VPC): 6 weeks | Core Cloud Platform Services (AWS/Azure): 8-10 weeks | Infrastructure as Code (Terraform): 6 weeks | Cloud Security, Cost & Reliability: 4-6 weeks
overlapNotes: Hands-on free-tier cloud provisioning runs throughout the study periods.

steps.title: Linux Administration & Cloud Networking Fundamentals
steps.description: Master Linux CLI, bash scripting, SSH keys, user management, and core networking: CIDR blocks, VPCs, public/private subnets, and security groups.
activities: Provision a custom multi-tier VPC with public and private subnets from scratch
Configure secure SSH bastion host access to private instances
steps.completionCriteria: Configured secure VPC with segregated public and private subnets and routing verified.

steps.title: Core Cloud Services (Compute, Storage, Databases)
steps.description: Master core AWS or Azure services: EC2/Virtual Machines, Auto Scaling Groups, Elastic Load Balancing, S3 object storage, and managed relational databases (RDS).
activities: Deploy a high-availability multi-AZ web application behind an Application Load Balancer with Auto Scaling
Configure S3 bucket cross-region replication and backup policies
steps.completionCriteria: Highly available, fault-tolerant web architecture deployed across multiple availability zones.

steps.title: Infrastructure as Code (IaC) with HashiCorp Terraform
steps.description: Define and automate cloud infrastructure using declarative HashiCorp Configuration Language (HCL), modularize components, and manage remote state in S3.
activities: Write reusable Terraform modules provisioning a complete VPC, ECS cluster, and RDS database
Store state files securely in an encrypted S3 bucket with DynamoDB state locking
steps.completionCriteria: Complete multi-tier cloud infrastructure provisioned in under 10 minutes via a single terraform apply command.

steps.title: Cloud Security, Cost Optimization & Associate Certification
steps.description: Implement Identity and Access Management (IAM) least-privilege policies, monitor costs with AWS Cost Explorer, and clear the AWS/Azure Solutions Architect exam.
activities: Audit IAM permissions to enforce least privilege using AWS IAM Access Analyzer
Clear the AWS Certified Solutions Architect - Associate or Azure Administrator exam
steps.completionCriteria: Pass recognized Associate Cloud Certification and present verified Credly badge.

title: DevOps Engineer Career Roadmap
description: Production automation curriculum: Linux system administration, Docker containerization, declarative CI/CD pipelines, Kubernetes cluster orchestration, and observability.
durationBreakdown: Linux & Scripting: 4-6 weeks | Docker & Containerization: 6 weeks | CI/CD Pipelines (GitHub Actions/GitLab): 6-8 weeks | Kubernetes (K8s) Cluster Management: 8-10 weeks | Observability (Prometheus/Grafana): 4 weeks
overlapNotes: Pipelines and Kubernetes manifests are version-controlled in Git from Day 1.

steps.title: Linux Systems, Networking & Shell Automation
steps.description: Master Linux administration (processes, permissions, systemd services), Bash scripting, SSH, and networking fundamentals (DNS, firewalls, ports).
activities: Write a Bash script that automates server health checks, disk usage alerts, and log rotation
Configure a hardened Linux server running non-root systemd daemon services
steps.completionCriteria: Automated server bootstrapping script that configures firewalls, users, and monitoring packages unattended.

steps.title: Containerization with Docker & Multi-Stage Builds
steps.description: Package applications into lightweight, secure container images using Docker, optimize image layers with multi-stage builds, and orchestrate with Docker Compose.
skillsToAcquire: Multi-Stage Builds for Minimal Image Size
activities: Write multi-stage Dockerfiles reducing a Node/Python image from 800MB to under 100MB
Run a multi-tier web application (app + database + cache) using docker-compose
steps.completionCriteria: Optimized Docker container images passing vulnerability scans with non-root security context.

steps.title: Continuous Integration & Continuous Delivery (CI/CD)
steps.description: Build automated CI/CD workflows using GitHub Actions or GitLab CI: automate unit testing, linting, Docker image building, scanning, and staging deployment.
activities: Create a complete GitHub Actions pipeline that triggers on pull requests, tests code, builds Docker images, and deploys to staging
Implement secret management and environment approval gates
steps.completionCriteria: Automated CI/CD pipeline executing test suites and deploying code on git push with zero manual intervention.

steps.title: Kubernetes (K8s) Orchestration & Production Observability
steps.description: Deploy and manage containerized microservices on Kubernetes (Pods, Deployments, Services, Ingress, ConfigMaps, Secrets), and monitor with Prometheus and Grafana.
activities: Deploy a resilient microservices application to a managed Kubernetes cluster (EKS/GKE or local Minikube)
Configure Prometheus scraping and design a Grafana dashboard showing request latency and error rates
steps.completionCriteria: Pass the Certified Kubernetes Administrator (CKA) exam and manage a production-grade K8s cluster.

title: Site Reliability Engineer (SRE) Roadmap
description: Reliability engineering pathway based on Google SRE model: SLIs/SLOs/Error Budgets, systems coding in Go/Python, distributed tracing, chaos testing, and incident post-mortems.

overlapNotes: Incident management runbooks are written while instrumenting test applications.

steps.title: SRE Philosophy, SLIs, SLOs & Error Budget Management
steps.description: Master Google SRE principles: Service Level Indicators (SLIs), Service Level Objectives (SLOs), Service Level Agreements (SLAs), and calculating Error Budgets.
activities: Define a complete SLO framework for an e-commerce checkout service
Calculate multi-window burn rate alert rules in Prometheus
steps.completionCriteria: Comprehensive SLO and error budget policy document with mathematical burn rate thresholds.

steps.title: Systems Automation & Tooling in Go or Python
steps.description: Write software automation tools to eliminate manual operational toil: custom CLI tools, Kubernetes controllers, or automated remediation daemons.
activities: Write a custom Go CLI tool that interrogates cloud resources, identifies idle instances, and cleans up orphaned volumes
Build a lightweight health check daemon that restarts failing processes automatically
steps.completionCriteria: Working Go/Python systems automation tool published on GitHub with unit tests.

steps.title: Distributed Tracing & Full-Stack Observability
steps.description: Implement distributed tracing with OpenTelemetry, aggregate metrics with Prometheus, collect logs with Loki, and visualize microservice call graphs in Jaeger.
activities: Instrument a microservices application with OpenTelemetry spans across HTTP calls
Analyze tail latency bottlenecks (p95, p99) on Jaeger traces
steps.completionCriteria: End-to-end observability stack visualizing latency bottlenecks across distributed microservices.

steps.title: Chaos Engineering, Incident Response & Blameless Post-Mortems
steps.description: Conduct fault injection experiments (Chaos Mesh / LitmusChaos), manage high-severity production incident bridges, author blameless post-mortems, and create runbooks.
activities: Simulate high latency and network partitions on a test Kubernetes cluster using Chaos Mesh
Write a formal blameless post-mortem document analyzing a simulated production outage
steps.completionCriteria: Documented chaos engineering test suite and verified blameless post-mortem with actionable root causes.

title: Database Administrator (DBA) Career Roadmap
description: Specialized database management pathway: relational storage engines, query execution plan tuning, replication, automated backup recovery, and cloud database migration.
durationBreakdown: Database Internals & Storage Engines: 6 weeks | Query Performance Tuning & Indexing: 6-8 weeks | High Availability & Replication: 6 weeks | Backup, Disaster Recovery & Cloud Migration: 6 weeks
overlapNotes: Disaster recovery restores are tested using simulated server crashes in virtual labs.

steps.title: Database Architecture, Storage Engines & Concurrency
steps.description: Understand Write-Ahead Logging (WAL), buffer pool memory allocation, page structures, transaction isolation levels, and lock contention.
activities: Configure memory allocation parameters (shared_buffers, work_mem) in PostgreSQL
Simulate concurrent transactions to trigger and resolve deadlock conditions
steps.completionCriteria: Tuned database configuration running on Linux with verified memory and connection limits.

steps.title: Query Optimization, Indexing & EXPLAIN Plan Analysis
steps.description: Analyze query execution plans using EXPLAIN ANALYZE, design optimal indexes (B-Tree, GIN, GiST), and eliminate sequential table scans.
activities: Optimize a slow multi-join query on a 10-million-row table reducing execution time from 15 seconds to under 50ms
Tune autovacuum settings to prevent table bloat
steps.completionCriteria: Sub-100ms response times achieved on complex analytical queries via optimal indexing.

resources.title: Use The Index, Luke! - SQL Indexing Guide
resources.name: Use The Index, Luke! - SQL Indexing Guide

steps.title: High Availability, Streaming Replication & Failover
steps.description: Configure master-standby streaming replication, manage replication lag, implement connection pooling (PgBouncer), and automate failover using Patroni.
activities: Setup a 3-node PostgreSQL high-availability cluster with streaming replication and automated failover
Benchmarking connection pooling performance under 1,000 concurrent client connections
steps.completionCriteria: High-availability database cluster executing automated master failover within 30 seconds of outage.

steps.title: Backup Strategies, Point-in-Time Recovery & Cloud DBs
steps.description: Implement automated physical and logical backup schedules (pg_dump, pgBackRest), execute Point-In-Time Recovery (PITR), and manage cloud databases (Amazon Aurora).
activities: Simulate database corruption and restore state to the exact second before data loss via PITR
Migrate an on-premise PostgreSQL database to Amazon RDS using AWS DMS
steps.completionCriteria: Successful zero-data-loss Point-in-Time Recovery demonstrated under simulated outage conditions.

title: Network Engineer (CCNA to Infrastructure) Roadmap
description: Structured networking pathway: IPv4/IPv6 subnetting, VLAN switching, OSPF/BGP dynamic routing, enterprise firewalls, and Python network automation.
durationBreakdown: IP Addressing & Subnetting: 4 weeks | Switching, VLANs & Trunking: 6 weeks | Routing Protocols (OSPF & BGP): 6-8 weeks | Network Security & Automation (Python/Ansible): 6 weeks
overlapNotes: Virtual network topologies are simulated in GNS3 or Packet Tracer throughout.

steps.title: IPv4/IPv6 Addressing, Subnetting & Network Layer Models
steps.description: Master binary to decimal conversion, IPv4 Classless Inter-Domain Routing (CIDR), Variable Length Subnet Masking (VLSM), and IPv6 address types.
activities: Perform 50+ timed subnetting calculations without using a calculator
Design a multi-department IP addressing scheme for a 1,000-host enterprise
steps.completionCriteria: Calculate network, broadcast, and usable host ranges for any CIDR mask in under 60 seconds.

steps.title: Switching Architecture, VLANs, Trunking & Spanning Tree
steps.description: Configure enterprise switches: Virtual LANs (VLANs), 802.1Q trunking, Inter-VLAN routing (Router-on-a-Stick), Spanning Tree Protocol (STP), and EtherChannel.
activities: Build a redundant campus switching topology in Cisco Packet Tracer preventing bridge loops with RSTP
Configure inter-VLAN routing and restrict management access with port security
steps.completionCriteria: Multi-VLAN redundant network topology functioning without packet broadcast storms.

steps.title: Dynamic Routing Protocols (OSPF & BGP) & WAN
steps.description: Implement dynamic interior and exterior routing: single-area and multi-area OSPF, route summarization, passive interfaces, and exterior BGP peering concepts.
activities: Configure multi-area OSPF across 6 routers in GNS3 with authentication and MD5 passwords
Simulate ISP redundant link failover using floating static routes and BGP basics
steps.completionCriteria: Fully converged multi-router enterprise WAN simulation with fast failover routing verified.

steps.title: Network Security (ACLs, Firewalls) & Python Automation
steps.description: Configure Access Control Lists (Standard/Extended ACLs), setup enterprise firewall rules, automate network device backups with Python (Netmiko), and clear CCNA.
activities: Write a Python script using Netmiko that connects to 10 switches via SSH and backs up running configurations
Clear the official Cisco CCNA (200-301) certification examination
steps.completionCriteria: Achieve CCNA 200-301 Certification and publish automated configuration scripts on GitHub.

title: Blockchain & Smart Contract Developer Roadmap
description: Comprehensive Web3 pathway: cryptographic foundations, Solidity programming, EVM opcode execution, gas optimization, smart contract security, and full-stack dApp engineering.
durationBreakdown: Blockchain Architecture & Cryptography: 4 weeks | Solidity Programming & Foundry: 8 weeks | DeFi Protocols & Token Standards (ERC-20/721): 6 weeks | Smart Contract Security & Full-Stack dApps: 6-8 weeks
overlapNotes: Smart contracts are written and tested with Foundry test suites continuously.

steps.title: Cryptography, Distributed Ledgers & EVM Architecture
steps.description: Understand public-key cryptography (ECDSA), SHA-256/Keccak hashing, Merkle trees, consensus mechanisms (Proof-of-Stake), and the Ethereum Virtual Machine (EVM).
activities: Sign and verify a cryptographic message in Python using secp256k1 keys
Inspect raw transaction receipts and gas usage on Etherscan/Polygonscan
steps.completionCriteria: Clear understanding of EVM gas consumption, nonces, and transaction execution stages.

steps.title: Solidity Programming, Foundry & Testing Frameworks
steps.description: Master Solidity syntax (data types, visibility, modifiers, events, inheritance), and develop, test, and debug contracts using the modern Foundry/Hardhat toolkit.
activities: Implement an ERC-20 token and custom staking contract with reward distribution logic
Write unit and fuzz tests in Solidity using Foundry achieving 100% line coverage
steps.completionCriteria: Fully tested smart contract suite with automated fuzz testing passing in Foundry.

steps.title: Token Standards (ERC-721/1155) & DeFi Mechanics
steps.description: Master NFT standards (ERC-721, ERC-1155), decentralized exchange Automated Market Makers (AMM - Uniswap v2 constant product formula), and lending protocol architectures.
activities: Build a simplified Decentralized Exchange (DEX) liquidity pool contract from scratch
Integrate Chainlink decentralized price feeds into a lending protocol simulator
steps.completionCriteria: Functional AMM swap contract tested with simulated liquidity deposits and token exchanges.

steps.title: Smart Contract Security, Auditing & Full-Stack dApp
steps.description: Audit critical vulnerabilities (Reentrancy, Integer Overflow, Front-Running), use Slither static analysis, connect contracts to a React frontend with Wagmi, and deploy to Sepolia testnet.
activities: Complete the Ethernaut security challenges on OpenZeppelin
Deploy a complete full-stack dApp with MetaMask wallet login on Polygon or Arbitrum testnet
steps.completionCriteria: Live deployed decentralized application on testnet with verified contract code on block explorer.

title: Embedded Systems & Firmware Engineer Roadmap
description: Hardware-software firmware engineering curriculum: low-level C bit manipulation, ARM Cortex-M architecture, peripheral protocols (I2C/SPI/UART/CAN), Real-Time Operating Systems (FreeRTOS), and debugging.
durationBreakdown: Embedded C & Bitwise Manipulation: 6 weeks | Microcontroller Peripherals & Protocols (UART/SPI/I2C): 8 weeks | FreeRTOS & Real-Time Multitasking: 6-8 weeks | Automotive Protocols (CAN) & Hardware Debugging: 6 weeks
overlapNotes: Hardware development boards are used from the first week of study.

steps.title: Embedded C Programming & Memory Architecture
steps.description: Master bitwise operators (masking, setting, clearing bits), pointers, volatile qualifier, memory-mapped I/O registers, and linker scripts.
activities: Write bare-metal register-level code to toggle GPIO pins and configure clock frequencies without HAL libraries
Simulate circular buffer memory management for serial data streams
steps.completionCriteria: Clean, bug-free C code manipulating hardware registers directly with proper bit masking.

steps.title: ARM Cortex-M Architecture & Communication Protocols
steps.description: Program hardware timer interrupts, ADC conversions, and serial communication buses (UART, SPI, I2C) on an ARM Cortex-M microcontroller (STM32).
activities: Interface an OLED display over I2C and an SD card over SPI simultaneously on an STM32 board
Write an interrupt-driven UART driver transmitting telemetry packets without CPU blocking
steps.completionCriteria: Functional multi-sensor embedded system communicating over multiple serial buses with zero data loss.

steps.title: Real-Time Operating Systems (FreeRTOS)
steps.description: Implement multi-tasking on microcontrollers using FreeRTOS: task scheduling, priorities, semaphores, mutexes, queue management, and priority inversion prevention.
activities: Build a multi-tasking environmental monitor with 4 independent FreeRTOS tasks (sensor reading, display, network, logging)
Identify and resolve deadlocks and race conditions in FreeRTOS tasks
steps.completionCriteria: Stable multi-threaded FreeRTOS firmware running without task starvation or priority inversion.

steps.title: Automotive Protocols (CAN Bus) & Hardware Debugging
steps.description: Learn Controller Area Network (CAN) bus protocol, differential signaling, arbitration, and debug firmware using Logic Analyzers and Digital Storage Oscilloscopes (DSO).
skillsToAcquire: Low Power Sleep Modes & Watchdog Timers
activities: Establish communication between two microcontroller nodes over a CAN transceiver bus
Decode I2C clock stretching and bus glitches using a digital logic analyzer
steps.completionCriteria: Working two-node CAN communication system with verified signal integrity on an oscilloscope.

description: Test automation curriculum: Object-Oriented Programming (Java/Python), web automation (Selenium/Playwright), Page Object Model (POM), API test automation, and CI/CD.
durationBreakdown: Core Programming & OOP (Java/Python): 6 weeks | Web Automation with Playwright / Selenium: 8 weeks | Framework Architecture (POM & TestNG): 6 weeks | API Automation & CI/CD Pipelines: 4-6 weeks
overlapNotes: Framework components are modularized as test scripts grow.

steps.title: Core Programming Language & Object-Oriented Principles
steps.description: Master core Java or Python: OOP inheritance, polymorphism, encapsulation, collections/lists, file handling, and exception handling.
activities: Solve 40+ coding problems focusing on strings, arrays, and collections
Build a console data processing utility adhering to clean code standards
steps.completionCriteria: Demonstrate solid problem-solving code with modular classes and exception handling.

steps.title: Web Automation with Playwright & Selenium WebDriver
steps.description: Master modern web automation: element locator strategies (XPath, CSS selectors, text locators), handling dynamic waits, alerts, iframes, and multiple windows.
activities: Automate user registration, product search, and cart addition on a demo e-commerce website
Handle dynamic elements and network wait states gracefully without flaky failures
steps.completionCriteria: Flake-free automated test suite executing end-to-end user workflows across Chrome and Firefox.

steps.title: Page Object Model (POM) & Test Framework Design
steps.description: Architect a maintainable test automation framework using Page Object Model (POM), data-driven testing (Excel/JSON data providers), and TestNG/PyTest assertions.
activities: Build an end-to-end Page Object Model test framework from scratch on GitHub
Integrate interactive HTML reporting (Allure Reports) with screenshot captures on test failure
steps.completionCriteria: Modular, maintainable automated test framework with rich HTML reports and zero hardcoded data.

steps.title: API Test Automation (RestAssured) & CI/CD Integration
steps.description: Automate RESTful API test suites using RestAssured (Java) or Requests (Python), and execute automated regression tests on GitHub Actions CI/CD.
activities: Automate an end-to-end API test suite validating user creation, token generation, and database updates
Configure a GitHub Actions workflow that runs automated regression tests on every pull request
steps.completionCriteria: Complete SDET portfolio repository with automated Web + API test frameworks triggered via CI/CD.

title: Product Designer (End-to-End) Career Roadmap
description: Comprehensive product design curriculum: connecting business strategy with user research, rapid prototyping, production UI design systems, and measuring conversion impact.

Draft a Product Opportunity Solution Tree aligning user problems to business revenue metrics
steps.completionCriteria: Clear problem framing document connecting user friction to concrete business metric improvements.

steps.title: Deep UX Architecture, Edge Cases & User Flows
steps.description: Map exhaustive user flows accounting for all edge cases (network drops, empty states, input errors, permission denials), and create clickable mid-fidelity prototypes.

Test the wireframe flow with 5 representative users
steps.completionCriteria: Complete user flow diagram covering 100% of edge cases, empty states, and permission dialogs.

steps.title: High-Fidelity Visual Craft & Scalable Design Systems
steps.description: Design production-grade high-fidelity screens in Figma, build accessible design tokens, create responsive layouts, and hand off specifications to engineering.
activities: Design the complete high-fidelity interface for a multi-tenant B2B SaaS dashboard
Create a structured component library in Figma with full documentation for frontend engineers
steps.completionCriteria: Pixel-perfect high-fidelity product design accompanied by a production-ready Figma component library.

steps.title: Post-Launch Measurement, A/B Testing & Whiteboarding
steps.description: Track post-launch metrics using analytics tools (Mixpanel/Amplitude), design A/B test variants, practice live whiteboard design challenges, and publish case studies.
activities: Participate in 5 mock whiteboard design challenges with senior product designers
Publish 2 end-to-end product case studies showcasing before/after business impact metrics
steps.completionCriteria: Published product design portfolio demonstrating business metric impact and mastery of live whiteboarding.

description: Technical communication curriculum: clear expository writing style, Markdown authoring, Git version control, REST API documentation (OpenAPI/Swagger), and static site generators.

Rewrite a confusing multi-paragraph open-source tutorial into concise step-by-step instructions
steps.completionCriteria: Clear, concise technical guide written in active voice with zero grammatical ambiguity.

steps.description: Adopt developer documentation workflows: writing in GitHub Flavored Markdown, managing branching in Git, authoring pull requests, and automating spellchecks.

Submit documentation pull requests to an active open-source project
steps.completionCriteria: Documented GitHub repository adhering to automated style linter checks without syntax errors.

steps.description: Document RESTful APIs: endpoints, authentication, headers, path parameters, request bodies, JSON responses, error codes, and author OpenAPI 3.0 YAML specifications.

Publish the interactive API documentation using Swagger UI or Redocly

Curate 4 diverse writing samples (Getting Started guide, API reference, Concept explanation, Troubleshooting guide)
steps.completionCriteria: Live published documentation website showcasing 4 verified writing samples across different formats.

steps.description: Master elicitation techniques (interviews, workshops, document analysis), stakeholder mapping (RACI matrix), and business requirements drafting.

Draft a RACI matrix and stakeholder communication plan

Draw UML sequence diagrams illustrating client-server-payment gateway interactions
steps.completionCriteria: Standard-compliant BPMN 2.0 swimlane workflow and UML diagrams verified by engineering criteria.

Create a Jira project with 25+ prioritized user stories with Gherkin acceptance criteria
steps.completionCriteria: Full BRD/FRD artifact and backlog of INVEST-compliant user stories configured in Jira.

Complete full-length ECBA exam simulations and apply for IIBA membership

Interview 8 users and construct a feature validation canvas
